mentions.title: WARNING!! Check all KING brand bearings before install
mentions.snippet: Explicit buyer-warning thread on a BMW enthusiast forum telling builders to inspect all King bearings before installation. Framed as a general QC warning rather than a single bad set.
mentions.replyNote: WebFetch failed with connection refused (ECONNREFUSED); could not read the thread.

mentions.title: WARNING about King Main Thrust Bearings
mentions.snippet: Buyer-warning thread on a diesel truck forum about King main thrust bearings. Titled as a warning to other builders, so it reads as more than a one-off install complaint.

mentions.title: King Main Bearings Defective
mentions.snippet: User reports King STDX main bearings with thrust bearings over 1mm too narrow to fit BMW S85/S65 blocks, returned for refund, and tells others King bearings cannot be trusted for these engines.
mentions.replyNote: WebFetch redirected to a tollbit.m5board.com mirror instead of returning page content; could not read within the Step 0 fetch budget.

mentions.title: King Bearings Quality?
mentions.snippet: Quality thread discussing a 2024 King main confirmed out of spec by King's own technical line plus a second bad 2025 main, with free spread named as the issue and concern it could lead to a spun bearing.
mentions.replyNote: Thread is readable and still open; no King or official brand response has been posted and it is not locked or marked resolved.

mentions.title: King Bearing - lack of professional help for quality control problem
mentions.snippet: Customer received a mis-packaged King XP bearing set (wrong sizes) and complains King refused to handle the return directly, redirecting them to the original supplier. Service complaint on top of a QC error.

mentions.title: Just call it what it is---King Bearings are no longer an option....
mentions.snippet: Critical thread arguing King bearings for 6-bolt DSM engines are effectively discontinued, on back-order since COVID, with posters steering builders to other brands.
